source_relation: Catalog revisions and official release tag revisions are recorded separately. The executed binaries are official release artifacts, not locally rebuilt catalog revisions.
acquisition: Download only the two repository-owned release asset URLs recorded in secrets-native-release-metadata.json.
Before extracting, verify each archive byte count and SHA256 against the official GitHub release asset metadata.
Select exactly one regular tar member whose basename is betterleaks or trufflehog respectively. Do not extract arbitrary paths, links, or other members.
Write that member into a private kit directory. Compare its byte count and SHA256 with secrets-native-pins.json before making it executable.

reproduction.input_files: Three fixed files are created from the pinned secrets-native-cases.json in a private temporary directory. No target path is accepted.
reproduction.environment: Only HOME, PATH, LC_ALL and TMPDIR are passed; HOME and TMPDIR point to the private temporary directory.

independent_checks: Compare native file paths, line numbers and detected secret bytes with the exact owned source fixture bytes.
Check Betterleaks native start and end columns, fingerprint and built-in rule identity.
Check TruffleHog native detector identity, filesystem source, plain decoder, unverified state and absence of verification-cache attribution.
Compare both producers' normalized source locations and secret hashes; reject missing, duplicate, extra or mismatching findings.
Require zero findings on both the clean file and the benign lookalike file.
not_claimed: GitHub metadata digest comparison is not a signed provenance attestation or an independently reproduced source build.
Native scanner rule coverage is not measured beyond these owned controls.
No real credential is read, validated, revoked, or transmitted.
The complete upstream test suites and full transitive dependency license review were not run.
